review:
Lucky Lu is a tiny 3x3 Irish-luck slot with five lines and one pick-style bonus. Three bonus symbols on reels 1, 2 and 3 trigger it.

The bonus shows five pots of gold. You click one to reveal a multiplier that's applied to your bet, with a maximum of 559x. It's an all-or-nothing reveal rather than a series of free spins. The bonus can also be bought where permitted, with the next spin triggering it. BGaming rates the game medium volatility, and the RTP is 96.07%. It's about as simple as a modern slot gets, ideal for a quick demo session.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
